title: Identity solution for Autonomous AIs living on Cardano

ms.promise:
This is a Concept proposal, with many risks of implementation. At this early stage, we feel the need for a small initial milestone to establish clearly all the specifications and tech stacks.
The output produced at this milestone: 
・A public GitHub repo
・A few video proof of some tech validation / Proof of concepts supporting the choice of the future tech stack
・Documented choice of tech stacks for the upcoming milestones
・Defined specifications for each component (NFT metadata, DID, VC content, etc…)
ms.criteria:
・we have a workable design and choice of tech to deliver this PoC
・we have identified risks, limitations, challenges…
・we are in a position to implement the next phases
ms.report:
This is for the month of March 2024. There is still one more month to finalise all the specs in this Milestone 1, but so far we have a good view of what can be done and how it would run. As described in the main video, there will be some impact on some specs / delivery in Milestone 3, which we will likely implement differently than initially planned.
・Public repo : https://github.com/incubiq/ai_identity
・Video report of activity (March 2024) : https://youtu.be/9zihWh4ZRi8 
・Extra video (PRISM bug report) : https://youtu.be/Iq1tMPdLraU

ms.promise:
Here the reviewed milestone output following the accepted change request to Catalyst. (change request here: https://github.com/incubiq/ai_identity/blob/main/1100164%20-%20Change%20request.pdf) 
・The onchain representation of the AI is its Identus identity wallet (not an NFT) ; Note: this is a major change from the initial spec
・Our identity open source node will issue and verify VCs 
・OSAIS to decompose an AI's attribute to resurface service providers (of GPU, of models, ...) 
・OSAIS to display in UI the status of an AI from its VCs (identity, performance, cost) 
・OSAIS to make use of the identity open source APIs to execute an AI's transaction and generate VC
ms.criteria:
Here the reviewed milestone acceptance criteria following the accepted change request to Catalyst.
・An AI is independent (not owned / has its own wallet) and uses independent service providers 
・An AI's service can be called 
・Each entity in the eco-system (caller, worker AI, service provider) receives a VC at execution of a request (VC will also contain proof of transaction cost for each entity)

ms.report:
Hello reviewers. This is the final milestone report:
・A 14min video report here: https://youtu.be/RL9bolGYcEU - Note: I state in the intro that it is the closing report, but it is only the milestone report, not the closing one. 
・A 5min close out video here: https://youtu.be/cdO7TyDPtqg
・A PDF close out report here: https://github.com/incubiq/ai_identity/blob/main/1100164%20-%20Closing%20report.pdf
・Up to date GitHub with all source code and install requirements: https://GitHub.com/incubiq/ai_identity
・Fully documented APIs here : https://incubiq.gitbook.io/opensourceais/identity-agent-lib
・A prod instance of the Cloud Identity Agent here : https://identity.opensourceais.com (note again, my side is Prod, but Identus is on testnet - still, I am hosting Identus myself on AWS as a pre-prod infra

All details of criteria, output, evidence etc... are in the video
Finally, as of right now, I have not switched the prod OpenSourceAIs.com to the Identity Cloud Agent, for the simple reason that all my infra is Prod-ready, but the current Identus infra I am relying on is on Testnet. Since if I plug it, it will generate test DIDs and VCs to all my eco-system (AIs, users, GPU providers...), then I cannot revert back to Prod, unless I wipe out all test env and reset for Prod. I hate to do this as it would not give a professional view of the solution if suddenly I wipe out all creds obtained by all parties in the ecosystem... so I will wait a little more, when Identus can be deployed on Mainnet.
Thank you!
